title: Patient names, labels, and raw filenames persist into storage UI exports and downloads
summary: Patient display names and raw filenames can be accepted, persisted, returned, displayed, exported, and used as download names.
remediation: Reject patient names, replace raw filenames with opaque document labels, use patient_id in UI/exports, and add canary privacy scans.

title: Windows launcher batch files allow install-path command injection
summary: Unquoted batch set assignments let metacharacters in install paths execute as the launching user.
remediation: Use quoted set syntax or replace batch launchers with a safer app launcher.

title: Admin reset utility duplicates secret env files into backups
summary: Admin reset copies the full secret .env to plaintext backups.
remediation: Avoid full .env backups or redact/exclude backup secrets.

title: API readiness harness can return live PHI and raw operation responses
summary: API quick-pull and operation-test paths can return names, TSV rows, raw JSON, or body previews from external patient APIs.
remediation: Apply direct-identifier minimization to API payloads and remove raw response/body persistence.

title: Login access intelligence trusts spoofable forwarding headers
summary: Login audit/access intelligence can treat caller-supplied forwarding headers as source IP.
remediation: Ignore forwarding headers unless behind a configured trusted proxy.

title: Counselors can enumerate and read arbitrary timeliness clients
summary: Counselor-allowed timeliness and review-source APIs query clients without ownership scoping.
remediation: Filter counselor reads to owned patients/charts or restrict routes to manager/admin and add negative access tests.

title: OAuth client credentials can be sent to cleartext HTTP token URLs
summary: The OAuth client-credentials helper accepts HTTP token URLs and can post secrets over cleartext transport.
remediation: Require HTTPS for token URLs except tightly controlled local synthetic tests.

title: Startup transcript can persist URL identifiers from access logs
summary: Startup transcript can capture Uvicorn access logs containing request paths/query strings.
remediation: Disable access logs or redact diagnostic bundles.

title: Rules evaluation response echoes PHI-capable source chart fields
summary: Rules responses include full source_fields from PHI-capable chart input.
remediation: Omit or sanitize source_fields before returning rule results.

title: Default bootstrap admin credential and reset behavior remain unsafe
summary: Static bootstrap admin defaults can create full admin access if a source/install flow misses randomization.
remediation: Fail readiness/startup for unsafe bootstrap defaults and disable reset-by-default for installed builds.

title: Raw request query strings are persisted in forensic audit logs
summary: Audit rows store request query strings verbatim, so PHI or secrets in query params become durable logs.
remediation: Redact or allowlist query strings before audit persistence.

title: CSV and clipboard exports allow spreadsheet formula injection
summary: CSV cells are quoted but formula-leading values are not neutralized before export/clipboard.
remediation: Prefix formula-leading cells and add export tests.

title: Tracked Loom metadata may expose preview URLs for identifiable chart recording
summary: Tracked reference metadata contains preview URLs for a recording described as containing identifiable chart content.
remediation: Remove/redact external media URLs and scan release/source artifacts.

title: Smoke script prints reset admin password
summary: Smoke reset mode prints the chosen admin password to stdout.
remediation: Do not print password values; print only reset status.

title: OpenAPI metadata can execute script in the admin API harness
summary: OpenAPI metadata is interpolated into HTML and assigned to innerHTML in the admin API harness.
remediation: Build the form with DOM/text APIs or strict escaping and add an XSS regression test.

title: Settings and audit paths expose vendor connection material
summary: Settings/audit payloads can expose API client IDs, endpoint URLs, token URLs, and vendor connection metadata.
remediation: Expose configured-state flags and redact connection material before audit/diagnostic output.

title: Unauthenticated readiness diagnostics expose local paths
summary: Public readiness details can include local database/upload/log paths.
remediation: Redact public readiness or require auth for detailed diagnostics.
